name: MaaPipelineEditor
notes: Built with React 19, TypeScript and React Flow, with a Go local service. Runs online without installation; the local service adds file management, screenshots and debugging. Imports v1 and v2 Pipeline protocols.
summary: A browser-based visual editor for MaaFramework Pipeline JSON that builds automation flows as connected nodes, with OCR and screenshot helpers, node templates, flow debugging and an optional local service.
